note: The Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China is among the national laws applied in Hong Kong (Basic Law, Annex III), so a Hong Kong Chinese resident's nationality is China's, and so are the rules on naturalising and on keeping it: China naturalises no one on residence alone (a discretionary grant to one settled in China or with other legitimate reasons, other nationalities given up), and a Chinese citizen settled abroad who voluntarily takes another nationality loses China's. Hong Kong permanent residence and its own passport are the passports engine's, not modelled here.

sources.title: Basic Law of the Hong Kong SAR, Annex III: National Laws to be Applied in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.said: The following national laws shall be applied locally with effect from 1 July 1997 by way of promulgation or legislation by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region: ... Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China
